shortDescription: Colombia's consumer prices rose 0.20% in October from September, official data showed on Monday, slowing from 0.37% the previous month, while 12-month inflation edged up to 6.30% from 6.29%.

children: Colombia's consumer prices rose 0.20% in October from September, official data showed on Monday, slowing from 0.37% the previous month, while 12-month inflation edged up to 6.30% from 6.29%.
The annual rate remains well above Colombia's 3% inflation target
Monthly price pressures were led by recreation and culture, which rose 0.44%, and housing, water, electricity, gas and other fuels, up 0.30%, according to statistics agency DANE
The inflation data lands as President Abelardo de la Espriella's government faces mounting fiscal strain

Congress recently approved a 2027 budget of 634.9 trillion pesos ($201.1 billion) that projects a fiscal deficit of 9.4% of gross domestic product, while Colombia is also pursuing a possible IMF arrangement that could unlock billions of dollars as it navigates a worsening fiscal crisis
